text:
nina: Quick kickoff: 'RefLaunch' Goal: tiny OSS refapp + how-to tutorial + reproducible bench + 30m webinar. Targets: 700 signups, 140 attendees.

otto: Dates?

nina: Publish May 16, webinar May 28. Drafts due Apr 28.

lee: Bench plan: cpu / small-gpu / q4 quant. Will report p50/p95 and cost per 1k tokens. Need canonical prompt set (support convo + doc summary + embeddings).

psalm: I'll write the tutorial and 6-tweet thread. Keep code examples minimal and add a one-click deploy badge.

otto: Repo: api + static demo, docker + GH Action smoke bench. README with expected metrics.

nina: Lead magnet: gated "Starter Playbook" PDF. Form fields: name, email, company size, role, interested in Dedicated? (checkbox). otto to wire.

lee: Bench runs Apr 30-May 3. Will attach CSV and a small plot for the blog.

psalm: Messaging angles: 1) forkable production starter, 2) reproducible bench you can run. Headline options: 
- "Fork and run a production-ready LLM starter in minutes"
- "Open starter for reliable LLM inference"

nina: Social TL;DR: one sentence + emoji. Create UTMs: campaign=reflaunch, source=(webinar|blog|tweet).

otto: Webinar format: 7-min demo video, 10-min bench walkthrough, live Q. Recording clip for promos.

launch-bot: Checklist created: https://ok.redwood/launch/reflaunch (repo, tutorial, bench, slides, gated pdf, form).

psalm: I'll draft blog outline by Apr 20. Need approvals by May 2.

nina: Owners: nina (launch), otto (repo + infra), psalm (content), lee (bench). Next sync Apr 26. :rocket:
